## berth tool

tools pinned to one exact version, installed at an org's start

### Synopsis

One exact version of a tool, installed with the image's mise when the org starts, so a program in it
matches what talks to it from outside. The source is a mise backend whose downloads mise verifies
(github:owner/repo or aqua:owner/repo); mise installs it with its checks on (attestations, provenance,
signatures, checksums), and an up or restart waits for it and fails if it didn't install. The running
container isn't touched: a change applies at the org's next up or restart.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_tool/

```
berth tool [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth tool set acme gadget github:acme/gadget 1.4.2
  berth tool ls acme
```
